title: Grok Writes 4,400 New Articles in First Week of Grokipedia v0.3

tickers.name: Space Exploration Technologies Corp. Class A Common Stock

summary:
Over 2,200 modifications are being made daily to an autonomous encyclopedia by AI. The system has produced more than 4,400 new entries for Grokipedia since the release of version 0.3 seven days ago, with most content generated from reader requests. Users can now monitor these updates in real time as the bot reviews and modifies the knowledge base on its own.

Elon Musk announced that Grok bots will manage the platform, shifting the responsibility of content maintenance to autonomous AI. This transition enables the software to update and improve articles across the database without manual human oversight.
